data.name: Jagravi
data.gender_notes: Jagravi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jagravi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jagrati' which means to be awake, alert, and radiant. The name Jagravi signifies a joyful and energetic person who is always awake to the beauty and wonder of the world around them. The name Jagravi carries the meaning “Joyful, Excited, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Jagravi usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, excited, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jagravi represents the awakened soul, always striving for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Jagravi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Excited, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagravi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

She is revered for her devotion and sacrifices to save her beloved husband from the clutches of Yama, the God of Death. This name personifies love, bravery, and loyalty.

historical_references.reference: Jagravi was a celebrated poetess of the Sanskrit literature from Kashmir during the 11th and 12th centuries.
historical_references.context: Jagravi was a prominent figure in the Kashmiri Saivism movement, and her works are known for their rich imagery and devotion to the god Shiva.

historical_references.reference: Another Jagravi, a queen of the Chalukya dynasty in the Deccan region of India during the 12th century, is known for her patronage of art and architecture.
historical_references.context: Queen Jagravi supported the construction of numerous temples and contributed significantly to the development of Chalukyan art and architecture.
